findings.rationale: The preceding Remarks explicitly promises diagrams of the two model graphs. Showing commands instead of the graph makes the key structural distinction (latent common cause U→X,U→Y versus observed X→Y) inaccessible in the rendered item.
findings.specific_content: Render two graph panels. Model A: dashed U with directed edges U→X and U→Y, with U marked latent and X,Y observed. Model B: observed X→Y. Preserve the current labels and avoid implying equivalence of the causal graphs; the body asserts equality only of the observational density and inequality of the intervention laws.
